title: [Style] Large-scale Japanese variety show water obstacle challenge special…
content:
[Style] Large-scale Japanese variety show water obstacle challenge special program (Japanese TV Game Show, Live-Action Broadcast), multi-camera real-time broadcast, 4K photorealistic photography, high-saturation summer colors, real-time throughout without slow motion.

[Duration] 30 seconds

[Reference] @ Image1 defines the challenger's face, hairstyle, body proportions, and full outfit. Use only the person. Do not use the grey studio background, the reference-sheet grid layout, or the multiple-view composition. Only one HANEUL exists in the video at all times.

[Character] HANEUL — adult Korean female, early 20s, strong and healthy athletic build. Straight black chin-length bob with full blunt bangs, brown eyes, small stud earrings. Outfit exactly as @ Image1: fitted black short-sleeve crop tee, grey pinstripe pleated micro skirt with a plain white elastic waistband (no legible text), white ankle socks, black chunky platform derby shoes. She speaks only Korean.

[Scene] Sunny outdoor large leisure pool obstacle course, five stages lined up from left to right. Stage 1: 5-meter high wooden jumping platform, Tarzan rope with pulley on overhead cable. Stage 2: 3-meter diameter red and yellow circular floating disc on the water, rotating continuously at a constant speed on an underwater axis, slippery surface. Stage 3: Four square floating blocks of varying distances, bobbing up and down with the waves. Stage 4: A slanted blue slippery climbing wall with grab ropes hanging from the top. Stage 5: A huge yellow cylindrical pipe spanning the water, wet reflective vinyl surface printed with red flame patterns, rotating continuously at a constant speed by a motor, just thick enough to be hugged by arms and legs, the right end connected to a small finish platform, directly below is a clear pool with no safety mats. Background includes palm trees, large water slides, light stands, commentary booth, temporary stands full of spectators. The entire film moves from left to right.

[Screen Graphics]
Top-left corner: a fictional program emblem — a hexagonal blue-and-red shield with a stylized white water-splash silhouette and the invented wordmark "SPLASH ATTACK". Fixed position and size, semi-transparent, present in every shot. Not based on any real brand or broadcaster.
Top-right corner: a digital countdown timer in a rounded white box, large bold numerals with one decimal place. It reads 90.0 when the start buzzer sounds and counts down continuously and visibly in 0.1 steps (90.0 → 89.9 → 89.8 ...) for the entire run. It never counts up and never resets. It freezes at 63.0 the instant she falls into the water and stays frozen and dimmed for the final shot.
Opening telop (visible 00:00-00:03 only, lower third): a pink-and-white broadcast nameplate — a magenta circle on the left containing the number "07"; to its right the name "HANEUL" in large bold letters with small katakana furigana "ハヌル" printed above it; directly below, a red banner strip reading "アイドル練習生". The nameplate slides in from the left, holds, then slides out. No other on-screen text anywhere in the video.

[Fixed Items] The position, size, color, and connection of the five stages remain unchanged throughout the film; only one challenger is always in the frame; hair and clothes are dry at the start and only naturally soaked after falling into the water; the circular floating disc and yellow pipe must be continuously rotating in all shots where they appear; the corner emblem and the countdown timer stay in the same corners at the same size in every shot.

[00:00-00:03] Shot 1: Tarzan rope launch (Eye-level Medium → Wide Pull-back, ENG Camera)
Visual: She stands on the edge of the 5-meter platform holding the rope, toes gripping the edge. Opening nameplate telop on screen. Timer reads 90.0 and starts running down on the buzzer, reaching 87.0.
Dialogue (Korean): {무조건 클리어합니다!}
Action: When the buzzer sounds, she kicks off forcefully, the pulley slides right along the cable, her body swings over the water in a pendulum arc, black bob and bangs blown back by the wind.
Commentary (Japanese): {まずはターザンロープ!}
SFX: Start buzzer, pulley sliding, crowd cheering.

[00:03-00:07] Shot 2: Landing on rotating disc (Fixed Side Shot)
Visual: Fixed camera on the side of the floating disc, showing the person, rope, and disc. Timer runs from 87.0 down to 83.0.
Scene: The red and yellow circular floating disc is rotating continuously at a constant speed on the water, the slippery surface reflecting light.
Action: She releases the rope and lands on the disc; as soon as her platform soles touch, she is carried sideways and backwards by the rotation. She spreads her arms and takes small, rapid steps in the opposite direction to offset the rotation, knees bent and center of gravity low, stabilizing after a few wobbles.
Expression: Eyebrows fly up, teeth clenched, then a quick grin.
Commentary (Japanese): {回転板だ! 耐えた!}
SFX: Low-frequency hum of the turntable axis, sound of soles rubbing, a burst of cheers.

[00:07-00:12] Shot 3: Floating board jumps (Dolly Track L→R)
Camera: Dolly camera moving parallel to the direction of progress, tracking from left to right. Timer runs from 83.0 down to 78.0.
Visual: Four square floating blocks bobbing up and down with the waves, unevenly spaced.
Action: She jumps from the edge of the turntable, crossing the floating blocks with four consecutive single-foot jumps. On the second block she missteps, the block sinks sharply, her upper body lunges forward and arms circle wildly for balance. Her right foot splashes in the water before she manages to step onto the third block, and the final jump lands both feet on the fourth block.
Dialogue (Korean): {아, 위험해...!}
Commentary (Japanese): {二枚目で崩れた! でも繋いだ!}
SFX: Muffled sound of blocks hitting water, splashing, intermittent gasps from the audience.

[00:12-00:17] Shot 4: Slippery climbing wall (Front 3/4 Medium Shot)
Visual: Front diagonal medium shot, showing the person, the sloped wall, and the grab ropes at the top. Timer runs from 78.0 down to 73.0.
Scene: The blue slanted wall is covered in running water, reflecting light.
Action: She runs up the wall, takes three steps, then her soles slip and she slides down a bit. She immediately drops her body to grab the wall, fingertips digging into the surface texture, and climbs again, right hand grabbing the rope hanging from the top, pulling herself up with arm strength.
Expression: Neck muscles tensed, forehead creased, wet bangs stuck to her forehead, breathing heavily.
Dialogue (Korean): {영차, 영차...!}
Commentary (Japanese): {滑る壁! 腕だけで登った!}
SFX: Friction on the wet wall, rope tightening, applause from the crowd.

[00:17-00:21] Shot 5: Hugging the rotating log (Rear Side Fixed Shot)
Visual: Slightly rear fixed side shot, clearly showing the pipe is rotating. Timer runs from 73.0 down to 69.0.
Scene: The yellow cylindrical pipe rotates continuously by a motor, a layer of water on the wet vinyl surface, red flame patterns rolling across the screen as it turns.
Action: She jumps from the top of the slope and straddles the base of the pipe, clamping it with her chest, stomach, arms, and legs. The rotation immediately carries her to the right; she adjusts her center of gravity in the opposite direction and shuffles toward the finish by moving her arms and legs in small increments.
Dialogue (Korean): {어, 돌아간다!?}
Commentary (Japanese): {回転丸太だ! これが最難関!}
SFX: Low-frequency motor sound, wet vinyl friction.

[00:21-00:26] Shot 6: Flipped over - Limit before finish (Front Close-up → Medium Pull-back)
Camera: Front close-up at the finish side slowly pulling back to a medium shot, camera axis remains unchanged. Timer runs from 69.0 down to 64.0.
Action: The pipe continues to rotate, slowly flipping her body to the right. Her center of gravity passes the highest point of the pipe and she can't pull it back. Her right leg detaches first, flailing in the air, then her right hand releases to reach for the finish platform, her full weight hanging by her left arm and leg as the pipe continues to rotate right.
Expression: Veins bulging at temples, arm muscles shaking, eyes wide.
Dialogue (Korean): {안 돼, 잠깐...!}
Commentary (Japanese): {回転に負けた! あと少し!}
Connection: Right fingertips are about 20cm from the finish platform, left hand still clinging to the rotating pipe.

fr.content:
[Style] Spécial programme de défi aquatique d’un grand variety show japonais (Japanese TV Game Show, Live-Action Broadcast), diffusion multi-caméras en temps réel, photographie photoréaliste 4K, couleurs estivales très saturées, en temps réel du début à la fin, sans ralenti.

[Duration] 30 secondes

[Reference] @ Image1 définit le visage, la coiffure, les proportions du corps et la tenue complète du challenger. Utiliser uniquement la personne. Ne pas utiliser le fond gris du studio, la grille de la feuille de référence ni la composition multi-vues. Une seule HANEUL existe à l’écran à tout moment.

[Character] HANEUL — femme coréenne adulte, début de la vingtaine, silhouette athlétique forte et saine. Carré noir droit à hauteur du menton avec frange pleine et nette, yeux marron, petites boucles d’oreilles clous. Tenue exactement comme sur @ Image1 : tee-shirt crop noir ajusté à manches courtes, mini-jupe plissée grise à fines rayures avec une ceinture élastique blanche unie (aucun texte lisible), chaussettes blanches à la cheville, chaussures derby noires à semelles compensées épaisses. Elle parle uniquement coréen.

[Scene] Parcours d’obstacles dans une grande piscine de loisirs en plein air, ensoleillée, avec cinq étapes alignées de gauche à droite. Étape 1 : plateforme de saut en bois de 5 mètres de haut, corde de Tarzan avec poulie sur câble aérien. Étape 2 : disque flottant circulaire rouge et jaune de 3 mètres de diamètre sur l’eau, tournant en continu à vitesse constante autour d’un axe sous-marin, surface glissante. Étape 3 : quatre blocs flottants carrés à distances variables, montant et descendant avec les vagues. Étape 4 : mur d’escalade bleu incliné et glissant avec des cordes de prise suspendues en haut. Étape 5 : énorme tuyau cylindrique jaune traversant l’eau, surface vinyle mouillée et réfléchissante imprimée de motifs de flammes rouges, tournant en continu à vitesse constante grâce à un moteur, juste assez épais pour être enlacé avec les bras et les jambes, l’extrémité droite reliée à une petite plateforme d’arrivée, directement en dessous se trouve une piscine claire sans tapis de sécurité. L’arrière-plan comprend des palmiers, de grands toboggans aquatiques, des projecteurs, une cabine de commentaires et des tribunes temporaires remplies de spectateurs. L’ensemble du film se déplace de gauche à droite.

[Screen Graphics]
Coin supérieur gauche : emblème fictif d’émission — un bouclier hexagonal bleu et rouge avec une silhouette stylisée d’éclaboussure d’eau blanche et le logo inventé « SPLASH ATTACK ». Position et taille fixes, semi-transparent, présent dans chaque plan. Ne repose sur aucune marque ni chaîne réelle.
Coin supérieur droit : minuteur numérique de compte à rebours dans un encadré blanc arrondi, grands chiffres gras avec un chiffre après la virgule. Il affiche 90.0 lorsque le buzzer de départ retentit et décompte en continu et visiblement par pas de 0.1 (90.0 → 89.9 → 89.8 ...) pendant toute la séquence. Il ne remonte jamais et ne se réinitialise jamais. Il se fige à 63.0 à l’instant où elle tombe dans l’eau et reste figé et assombri pour le plan final.
Telop d’ouverture (visible uniquement de 00:00 à 00:03, lower third) : un bandeau d’émission rose et blanc — un cercle magenta à gauche contenant le numéro « 07 » ; à sa droite, le nom « HANEUL » en grandes lettres grasses avec le petit furigana katakana « ハヌル » imprimé au-dessus ; juste en dessous, une bande rouge indiquant « アイドル練習生 ». Le bandeau entre par la gauche, reste en place, puis ressort vers la gauche. Aucun autre texte à l’écran nulle part dans la vidéo.

[Fixed Items] La position, la taille, la couleur et la connexion des cinq étapes restent inchangées tout au long du film ; une seule challenger est toujours dans le cadre ; les cheveux et les vêtements sont secs au départ et ne sont naturellement trempés qu’après la chute dans l’eau ; le disque flottant circulaire et le tuyau jaune doivent tourner en continu dans tous les plans où ils apparaissent ; l’emblème de coin et le minuteur restent dans les mêmes coins, à la même taille, dans chaque plan.

[00:00-00:03] Shot 1 : Lancement à la corde de Tarzan (Eye-level Medium → Wide Pull-back, ENG Camera)
Visual : Elle se tient au bord de la plateforme de 5 mètres en tenant la corde, les orteils agrippés au rebord. Telop d’ouverture à l’écran. Le minuteur affiche 90.0 et commence à décompter au buzzer, atteignant 87.0.
Dialogue (Korean): {무조건 클리어합니다!}
Action : Quand le buzzer retentit, elle pousse violemment, la poulie glisse vers la droite le long du câble, son corps se balance au-dessus de l’eau en arc de pendule, son carré noir et sa frange repoussés par le vent.
Commentary (Japanese): {まずはターザンロープ!}
SFX : Buzzer de départ, glissement de la poulie, acclamations de la foule.

[00:03-00:07] Shot 2 : Atterrissage sur le disque tournant (Fixed Side Shot)
Visual : Caméra fixe sur le côté du disque flottant, montrant la personne, la corde et le disque. Le minuteur passe de 87.0 à 83.0.
Scene : Le disque flottant circulaire rouge et jaune tourne en continu à vitesse constante sur l’eau, sa surface glissante reflétant la lumière.
Action : Elle lâche la corde et atterrit sur le disque ; dès que ses semelles touchent la surface, la rotation l’emporte latéralement et vers l’arrière. Elle écarte les bras et fait de petits pas rapides dans le sens opposé pour compenser la rotation, genoux fléchis et centre de gravité bas, se stabilisant après quelques oscillations.
Expression : Les sourcils se haussent, les dents serrées, puis un bref sourire.
Commentary (Japanese): {回転板だ! 耐えた!}
SFX : Ronronnement grave de l’axe du plateau tournant, frottement des semelles, explosion d’acclamations.

[00:07-00:12] Shot 3 : Sauts sur les blocs flottants (Dolly Track L→R)
Camera : Caméra dolly se déplaçant parallèlement à la progression, suivant de gauche à droite. Le minuteur passe de 83.0 à 78.0.
Visual : Quatre blocs flottants carrés qui montent et descendent avec les vagues, espacés de manière irrégulière.
Action : Elle saute depuis le bord du plateau tournant et traverse les blocs flottants en quatre sauts consécutifs sur un seul pied. Sur le deuxième bloc, elle rate son appui, le bloc s’enfonce brusquement, son buste part vers l’avant et ses bras moulinent pour garder l’équilibre. Son pied droit éclabousse l’eau avant qu’elle ne parvienne à poser le pied sur le troisième bloc, et le dernier saut se termine avec les deux pieds sur le quatrième bloc.
Dialogue (Korean): {아, 위험해...!}
Commentary (Japanese): {二枚目で崩れた! でも繋いだ!}
SFX : Bruit étouffé des blocs frappant l’eau, éclaboussures, halètements intermittents du public.

[00:12-00:17] Shot 4 : Mur d’escalade glissant (Front 3/4 Medium Shot)
Visual : Plan moyen frontal en diagonale, montrant la personne, le mur incliné et les cordes de prise en haut. Le minuteur passe de 78.0 à 73.0.
Scene : Le mur bleu incliné est couvert d’eau courante et reflète la lumière.
Action : Elle court sur le mur, fait trois pas, puis ses semelles glissent et elle redescend un peu. Elle plaque immédiatement son corps contre le mur pour s’y agripper, les doigts cherchant prise dans la texture de la surface, puis recommence à grimper, la main droite attrapant la corde suspendue en haut, se hissant grâce à la force des bras.
Expression : Les muscles du cou tendus, le front plissé, la frange mouillée collée au front, respiration haletante.
Dialogue (Korean): {영차, 영차...!}
Commentary (Japanese): {滑る壁! 腕だけで登った!}
SFX : Frottement sur le mur mouillé, corde qui se tend, applaudissements de la foule.

---
[Style] 大規模な日本のバラエティ番組の水上障害物チャレンジ特番（日本のテレビゲームショー、実写中継）、マルチカメラのリアルタイム放送、4Kフォトリアル撮影、高彩度の夏色、スローモーションなしで全編リアルタイム。

[Duration] 30秒

[Reference] @ Image1 は挑戦者の顔、髪型、体型、全身の衣装を定義する。人物のみを使用すること。グレーのスタジオ背景、参照シートのグリッドレイアウト、複数視点の構成は使用しないこと。動画内には常に HANEUL が1人だけ存在する。

[Character] HANEUL — 成人の韓国人女性、20代前半、引き締まって健康的なアスリート体型。まっすぐな黒髪の顎上ボブ、ぱっつん前髪、茶色の目、小さなスタッドピアス。衣装は @ Image1 と完全に同じ：体にフィットした黒の半袖クロップT、白い文字のないプレーンな白いウエストゴム付きのグレーのピンストライプ・プリーツ・マイクロスカート、白いアンクルソックス、黒の厚底ダービーシューズ。話すのは韓国語のみ。

[Scene] 晴れた屋外の大型レジャープール障害物コース、左から右へ5ステージが並ぶ。Stage 1: 高さ5メートルの木製ジャンプ台、頭上のケーブルに滑車が付いたターザンロープ。Stage 2: 水上にある直径3メートルの赤と黄色の円形フローティングディスク、底面の軸で一定速度で連続回転、滑りやすい表面。Stage 3: 距離の異なる4つの四角いフローティングブロック、波で上下に揺れる。Stage 4: 上部からロープが垂れ下がる、傾斜した青い滑りやすいクライミングウォール。Stage 5: 水面をまたぐ巨大な黄色の円筒パイプ、赤い炎模様が印刷された濡れた反射性ビニール表面、モーターで一定速度で連続回転、腕と脚で抱きつける程度の太さ、右端は小さなゴール台につながっており、その真下には安全マットのない透明なプールがある。背景にはヤシの木、大型ウォータースライダー、照明スタンド、実況ブース、観客でいっぱいの仮設スタンド。映像全体は左から右へ進行する。

[Screen Graphics]
左上隅: 架空の番組エンブレム — 六角形の青と赤の盾に、白い水しぶきのシルエットと創作ワードマーク "SPLASH ATTACK"。固定位置・固定サイズ、半透明、全ショットに表示。実在のブランドや放送局には基づかない。
右上隅: 角丸の白いボックス内に表示されるデジタルカウントダウンタイマー。大きく太い数字、小数点以下1桁。スタートブザーが鳴った瞬間に 90.0 を表示し、全行程を通して 0.1 刻みで連続的かつ視認可能にカウントダウンする（90.0 → 89.9 → 89.8 ...）。カウントアップもリセットもしない。彼女が水に落ちた瞬間に 63.0 で停止し、最後のショットでは暗くなったまま固定される。
オープニングテロップ（00:00-00:03 のみ表示、下3分の1）: ピンクと白の放送用ネームプレート — 左にマゼンタの円、その中に数字 "07"；右に大きな太字で "HANEUL"、その上に小さなカタカナのふりがな "ハヌル"；その直下に赤い帯で "アイドル練習生"。ネームプレートは左からスライドインし、停止し、その後左へスライドアウトする。動画内の他の場所にテキストは一切表示しない。

[Fixed Items] 5つのステージの位置、サイズ、色、接続は映像全体を通して変わらないこと。常にフレーム内には挑戦者は1人だけであること。髪と服は開始時点では乾いており、水に落ちた後にのみ自然に濡れること。円形フローティングディスクと黄色いパイプは、登場する全ショットで連続回転していなければならないこと。コーナーのエンブレムとカウントダウンタイマーは、全ショットで同じ角に同じサイズで表示されること。

[00:00-00:03] Shot 1: ターザンロープ発進（Eye-level Medium → Wide Pull-back, ENG Camera）
Visual: 彼女は5メートルの台の縁に立ち、ロープを握り、つま先で縁をつかんでいる。オープニングのネームプレートテロップが画面に表示される。タイマーは 90.0 を示し、ブザーとともにカウントダウンを開始して 87.0 に達する。
Dialogue (Korean): {무조건 클리어합니다!}
Action: ブザーが鳴ると、彼女は勢いよく踏み切り、滑車がケーブルに沿って右へ滑り、体は振り子の弧を描いて水面上をスイングする。黒いボブと前髪は風で後ろへ流れる。
Commentary (Japanese): {まずはターザンロープ!}
SFX: スタートブザー、滑車が滑る音、観客の歓声。

[00:03-00:07] Shot 2: 回転ディスクへの着地（Fixed Side Shot）
Visual: フローティングディスクの側面からの固定カメラで、人物、ロープ、ディスクが見える。タイマーは 87.0 から 83.0 へ進む。
Scene: 赤と黄色の円形フローティングディスクは、水上で一定速度で連続回転しており、滑りやすい表面が光を反射している。
Action: 彼女はロープを離してディスクに着地する。プラットフォームソールが触れた瞬間、回転によって横方向かつ後方へ運ばれる。彼女は腕を広げ、回転に逆らうように小刻みで素早いステップを踏み、膝を曲げて重心を低く保ち、数回ふらついたあとに安定させる。
Expression: 眉が跳ね上がり、歯を食いしばり、その後すぐに笑み。
Commentary (Japanese): {回転板だ! 耐えた!}
SFX: ターンテーブル軸の低周波ハム音、靴底が擦れる音、歓声の爆発。

[00:07-00:12] Shot 3: フローティングボードジャンプ（Dolly Track L→R）
Camera: 進行方向に平行して動くドリーカメラ、左から右へ追従。タイマーは 83.0 から 78.0 へ進む。
Visual: 波で上下に揺れる4つの四角いフローティングブロックが、ばらばらの間隔で並ぶ。

ko.content:
[스타일] 대규모 일본 버라이어티 쇼 수중 장애물 챌린지 특집 프로그램 (일본 TV 게임쇼, 라이브 액션 방송), 멀티카메라 실시간 중계, 4K 포토리얼리스틱 촬영, 고채도 여름 색감, 전 구간 실시간 진행, 슬로모션 없음.

[길이] 30초

[레퍼런스] @ Image1은 도전자의 얼굴, 헤어스타일, 체형 비율, 전체 의상을 정의한다. 인물만 사용한다. 회색 스튜디오 배경, 레퍼런스 시트 그리드 레이아웃, 멀티뷰 구성은 사용하지 않는다. 영상 전체에서 HANEUL은 오직 한 명만 존재한다.

[캐릭터] HANEUL — 성인 한국인 여성, 20대 초반, 탄탄하고 건강한 운동 체형. 일자 흑발의 턱선 길이 보브컷과 풀 뱅, 갈색 눈, 작은 스터드 귀걸이. 의상은 @ Image1과 정확히 동일: 몸에 맞는 검은색 반팔 크롭 티, 무지 흰색 허리밴드가 있는 회색 핀스트라이프 플리츠 마이크로 스커트(읽을 수 있는 텍스트 없음), 흰색 앵클 양말, 검은색 청키 플랫폼 더비 슈즈. 한국어만 말한다.

[장면] 맑은 야외 대형 레저 풀 장애물 코스, 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 다섯 스테이지가 일렬로 배치됨. 스테이지 1: 높이 5m의 목재 점프 플랫폼, 상부 케이블에 풀리가 달린 타잔 로프. 스테이지 2: 물 위에 떠 있는 지름 3m의 빨강과 노랑 원형 플로팅 디스크, 수중 축을 중심으로 일정한 속도로 계속 회전, 미끄러운 표면. 스테이지 3: 서로 다른 간격으로 배치된 네 개의 정사각형 플로팅 블록, 파도에 따라 위아래로 흔들림. 스테이지 4: 상단에 잡을 수 있는 로프가 매달린 경사진 파란색 미끄러운 클라이밍 월. 스테이지 5: 물 위를 가로지르는 거대한 노란색 원통형 파이프, 빨간 불꽃 패턴이 인쇄된 젖은 반사성 비닐 표면, 모터로 일정한 속도로 계속 회전, 팔과 다리로 감싸 안을 수 있을 정도로만 두꺼움, 오른쪽 끝은 작은 피니시 플랫폼과 연결되어 있으며 바로 아래는 안전 매트가 없는 맑은 풀. 배경에는 야자수, 대형 워터슬라이드, 조명 스탠드, 중계 부스, 관중으로 가득 찬 임시 관람석이 포함됨. 전체 영상은 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 진행된다.

[화면 그래픽]
좌측 상단: 가상의 프로그램 엠블럼 — 육각형의 파란색과 빨간색 방패 모양에 스타일화된 흰색 물보라 실루엣과 창작 워드마크 "SPLASH ATTACK". 고정된 위치와 크기, 반투명, 모든 샷에 등장. 실제 브랜드나 방송사와 무관함.
우측 상단: 둥근 흰색 박스 안의 디지털 카운트다운 타이머, 큰 굵은 숫자와 소수점 한 자리. 시작 버저가 울릴 때 90.0으로 표시되며, 전 구간 동안 0.1 단위로 계속 눈에 보이게 감소한다(90.0 → 89.9 → 89.8 ...). 절대 올라가지 않으며 리셋되지 않는다. 그녀가 물에 떨어지는 순간 63.0에서 멈추고, 마지막 샷에서는 고정된 채 어둡게 처리된다.
오프닝 텔롭(00:00-00:03에만 표시, 하단 3분의 1): 분홍색과 흰색의 방송용 네임플레이트 — 왼쪽에 숫자 "07"이 들어간 마젠타색 원; 그 오른쪽에 큰 굵은 글씨로 이름 "HANEUL", 그 위에 작은 가타카나 후리가나 "ハヌル" 표기; 바로 아래에는 빨간 배너 스트립에 "アイドル練習生"이라고 적혀 있음. 네임플레이트는 왼쪽에서 들어와 잠시 유지된 뒤 왼쪽으로 나간다. 영상 내 다른 온스크린 텍스트는 없음.

[고정 요소] 다섯 스테이지의 위치, 크기, 색상, 연결 상태는 영상 내내 변하지 않는다. 프레임에는 항상 도전자가 한 명만 있다. 머리와 옷은 시작 시 마른 상태이며, 물에 떨어진 뒤에만 자연스럽게 젖는다. 원형 플로팅 디스크와 노란 파이프는 등장하는 모든 샷에서 계속 회전해야 한다. 코너 엠블럼과 카운트다운 타이머는 모든 샷에서 같은 코너, 같은 크기로 유지된다.

[00:00-00:03] 샷 1: 타잔 로프 출발 (아이 레벨 미디엄 → 와이드 풀백, ENG Camera)
비주얼: 그녀는 5m 플랫폼 가장자리에 서서 로프를 잡고 있으며, 발끝으로 가장자리를 딛고 있다. 오프닝 네임플레이트 텔롭이 화면에 표시된다. 타이머는 90.0을 가리키고 버저와 함께 카운트다운을 시작해 87.0에 도달한다.
대사(한국어): {무조건 클리어합니다!}
액션: 버저가 울리자 그녀는 강하게 박차고 나가며, 풀리가 케이블을 따라 오른쪽으로 미끄러지고, 몸은 물 위를 진자 궤적으로 휘두르며, 검은 보브컷과 앞머리는 바람에 뒤로 날린다.
해설(일본어): {まずはターザンロープ!}
SFX: 시작 버저, 풀리 미끄러지는 소리, 관중 환호.

[00:03-00:07] 샷 2: 회전 디스크 착지 (고정 사이드 샷)
비주얼: 플로팅 디스크 측면에 고정된 카메라로 사람, 로프, 디스크를 보여준다. 타이머는 87.0에서 83.0까지 내려간다.
장면: 빨강과 노랑의 원형 플로팅 디스크가 물 위에서 일정한 속도로 계속 회전하고 있으며, 미끄러운 표면이 빛을 반사한다.
액션: 그녀는 로프를 놓고 디스크에 착지한다. 플랫폼 슈즈가 닿자마자 회전에 의해 옆과 뒤로 밀려난다. 그녀는 팔을 벌리고 회전의 반대 방향으로 작은 빠른 발걸음을 내디디며, 무릎을 굽히고 중심을 낮춰 몇 번 흔들린 뒤 안정시킨다.
표정: 눈썹이 치켜 올라가고, 이를 악물었다가, 곧 짧게 미소 짓는다.
해설(일본어): {回転板だ! 耐えた!}
SFX: 턴테이블 축의 저주파 웅웅거림, 밑창이 문질러지는 소리, 터져 나오는 환호.

[00:07-00:12] 샷 3: 플로팅 보드 점프 (돌리 트랙 L→R)
카메라: 진행 방향과 평행하게 움직이는 돌리 카메라, 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 트래킹. 타이머는 83.0에서 78.0까지 내려간다.
비주얼: 네 개의 정사각형 플로팅 블록이 파도에 따라 위아래로 흔들리며, 간격이 제각각이다.
액션: 그녀는 턴테이블 가장자리에서 뛰어내려, 네 번 연속 한 발 점프로 플로팅 블록을 건넌다. 두 번째 블록에서 발을 헛디뎌 블록이 급격히 가라앉고, 상체가 앞으로 쏠리며 팔이 크게 휘둘러져 균형을 잡는다. 오른발이 물에 튀긴 뒤 간신히 세 번째 블록에 올라서고, 마지막 점프는 양발로 네 번째 블록에 착지한다.
대사(한국어): {아, 위험해...!}
해설(일본어): {二枚目で崩れた! でも繋いだ!}
SFX:

pt.content:
[Style] Programa especial de desafio em obstáculo aquático de um grande variety show japonês (Japanese TV Game Show, transmissão live-action), transmissão em tempo real com múltiplas câmeras, fotografia fotorrealista em 4K, cores de verão com alta saturação, em tempo real o tempo todo, sem slow motion.

[Duration] 30 seconds

[Reference] @ Image1 defines the challenger's face, hairstyle, body proportions, and full outfit. Use only the person. Do not use the grey studio background, the reference-sheet grid layout, or the multiple-view composition. Only one HANEUL exists in the video at all times.

[Character] HANEUL — adult Korean female, early 20s, strong and healthy athletic build. Straight black chin-length bob with full blunt bangs, brown eyes, small stud earrings. Outfit exactly as @ Image1: fitted black short-sleeve crop tee, grey pinstripe pleated micro skirt with a plain white elastic waistband (no legible text), white ankle socks, black chunky platform derby shoes. She speaks only Korean.

[Scene] Sunny outdoor large leisure pool obstacle course, five stages lined up from left to right. Stage 1: 5-meter high wooden jumping platform, Tarzan rope with pulley on overhead cable. Stage 2: 3-meter diameter red and yellow circular floating disc on the water, rotating continuously at a constant speed on an underwater axis, slippery surface. Stage 3: Four square floating blocks of varying distances, bobbing up and down with the waves. Stage 4: A slanted blue slippery climbing wall with grab ropes hanging from the top. Stage 5: A huge yellow cylindrical pipe spanning the water, wet reflective vinyl surface printed with red flame patterns, rotating continuously at a constant speed by a motor, just thick enough to be hugged by arms and legs, the right end connected to a small finish platform, directly below is a clear pool with no safety mats. Background includes palm trees, large water slides, light stands, commentary booth, temporary stands full of spectators. The entire film moves from left to right.

[Screen Graphics]
Top-left corner: a fictional program emblem — a hexagonal blue-and-red shield with a stylized white water-splash silhouette and the invented wordmark "SPLASH ATTACK". Fixed position and size, semi-transparent, present in every shot. Not based on any real brand or broadcaster.
Top-right corner: a digital countdown timer in a rounded white box, large bold numerals with one decimal place. It reads 90.0 when the start buzzer sounds and counts down continuously and visibly in 0.1 steps (90.0 → 89.9 → 89.8 ...) for the entire run. It never counts up and never resets. It freezes at 63.0 the instant she falls into the water and stays frozen and dimmed for the final shot.
Opening telop (visible 00:00-00:03 only, lower third): a pink-and-white broadcast nameplate — a magenta circle on the left containing the number "07"; to its right the name "HANEUL" in large bold letters with small katakana furigana "ハヌル" printed above it; directly below, a red banner strip reading "アイドル練習生". The nameplate slides in from the left, holds, then slides out. No other on-screen text anywhere in the video.

[Fixed Items] The position, size, color, and connection of the five stages remain unchanged throughout the film; only one challenger is always in the frame; hair and clothes are dry at the start and only naturally soaked after falling into the water; the circular floating disc and yellow pipe must be continuously rotating in all shots where they appear; the corner emblem and the countdown timer stay in the same corners at the same size in every shot.

[00:00-00:03] Shot 1: Lançamento na corda Tarzan (Eye-level Medium → Wide Pull-back, ENG Camera)
Visual: She stands on the edge of the 5-meter platform holding the rope, toes gripping the edge. Opening nameplate telop on screen. Timer reads 90.0 and starts running down on the buzzer, reaching 87.0.
Dialogue (Korean): {무조건 클리어합니다!}
Action: When the buzzer sounds, she kicks off forcefully, the pulley slides right along the cable, her body swings over the water in a pendulum arc, black bob and bangs blown back by the wind.
Commentary (Japanese): {まずはターザンロープ!}
SFX: Start buzzer, pulley sliding, crowd cheering.

[00:03-00:07] Shot 2: Landing on rotating disc (Fixed Side Shot)
Visual: Fixed camera on the side of the floating disc, showing the person, rope, and disc. Timer runs from 87.0 down to 83.0.
Scene: The red and yellow circular floating disc is rotating continuously at a constant speed on the water, the slippery surface reflecting light.
Action: She releases the rope and lands on the disc; as soon as her platform soles touch, she is carried sideways and backwards by the rotation. She spreads her arms and takes small, rapid steps in the opposite direction to offset the rotation, knees bent and center of gravity low, stabilizing after a few wobbles.
Expression: Eyebrows fly up, teeth clenched, then a quick grin.
Commentary (Japanese): {回転板だ! 耐えた!}
SFX: Low-frequency hum of the turntable axis, sound of soles rubbing, a burst of cheers.

[00:07-00:12] Shot 3: Saltos nos blocos flutuantes (Dolly Track L→R)

[风格] 大型日本综艺水上障碍挑战特别节目（日本电视游戏节目，实景直播），多机位实时转播，4K 写实摄影，高饱和夏日色彩，全程实时呈现，不使用慢动作。

[时长] 30 秒

[参考] @ Image1 定义挑战者的脸、发型、身体比例和整套服装。仅使用这个人物。不要使用灰色摄影棚背景、参考图表格布局或多视角组合。视频中始终只有一个 HANEUL。

[角色] HANEUL — 成年韩国女性，20 岁出头，强壮健康的运动型体格。黑色直发齐下巴短波波头，齐整厚重刘海，棕色眼睛，小号耳钉。服装与 @ Image1 完全一致：修身黑色短袖露脐上衣、灰色细条纹百褶超短裙，配纯白色松紧腰头（无可辨识文字）、白色踝袜、黑色厚底德比鞋。她只说韩语。

[场景] 阳光明媚的户外大型休闲泳池障碍赛道，五个关卡从左到右依次排列。第 1 关：5 米高木制跳台，带滑轮的泰山绳悬挂在上方缆线上。第 2 关：水面上直径 3 米的红黄相间圆形浮盘，围绕水下轴以恒定速度持续旋转，表面湿滑。第 3 关：四个方形浮块，间距各不相同，随波浪上下起伏。第 4 关：倾斜的蓝色湿滑攀爬墙，顶部垂下抓握绳。第 5 关：横跨水面的巨大黄色圆柱管，湿亮的乙烯基表面印有红色火焰图案，由电机以恒定速度持续旋转，粗细刚好能用手脚环抱，右端连接一个小型终点平台，下方直接是清澈泳池，没有安全垫。背景包括棕榈树、大型水滑梯、灯架、解说席、坐满观众的临时看台。整部影片从左向右推进。

[画面图形]
左上角：虚构节目徽章——一个蓝红双色六边形盾牌，内含风格化白色水花剪影与虚构字标 “SPLASH ATTACK”。固定位置与大小，半透明，每个镜头都出现。非基于任何真实品牌或电视台。
右上角：数字倒计时器，置于圆角白色框内，大号粗体数字，保留一位小数。起始蜂鸣响起时显示 90.0，并在整个过程中以 0.1 为步进持续、可见地倒数（90.0 → 89.9 → 89.8 ...）。不会递增，也不会重置。她落入水中的瞬间冻结在 63.0，并在最后一个镜头中保持冻结且变暗。
开场字幕条（仅 00:00-00:03 可见，画面下三分之一）：粉白色转播名牌——左侧为洋红色圆形，内含数字 “07”；右侧为大号粗体字 “HANEUL”，上方印有小号片假名振假名 “ハヌル”；其下方直接是一条红色横幅，写着 “アイドル練習生”。名牌从左侧滑入，停留，然后滑出。视频中其他任何位置都不出现文字。
